classification: Source correction and software reproduction of installed machine-id failure; no physical repair/DHCP/SSH acceptance

diagnosis.actual_service: systemd-networkd runs as systemd-network (998:998); generated MAC-matched DHCPv4 config does not override ClientIdentifier.
diagnosis.source_chain: Pinned systemd252.39 DHCP default DUID -> dhcp_identifier_set_duid_en -> sd_id128_get_machine -> /etc/machine-id. host-init bind-mounts state identity onto /etc/machine-id before systemd.

library_reproduction.method: Worker executed native and deployed ARM libsystemd sd_id128_get_machine in a private mount namespace, with the same file bind and UID/GID998:998; parent identity directory stays0700. ARM library runs under QEMU user mode.
library_reproduction.interpretation: Confirms machine-id read failure and correction; does not execute networkd DHCP or prove physical lease acquisition.

changes.legacy_upgrade: Management prepare chmods guarded bound identity before PID1, after all identity/mount guards. No key/config permission change.
changes.validators: Accept legacy0600/new0644 only for machine-id; preserve0600 keys/config.
changes.diagnostics: Fixed IPv4 timeout text without printing arbitrary exception/secret material.
changes.recovery: docs/installed-host-repair-20261107.md checks known idle NVMe and state UUID, changes one file permission, fsyncs/unmounts; no reinstall or SPI write.
changes.installer: Exact-target yes/no; acquisition hashes during download; prepare authenticates encoded bytes; apply authenticates encoded bytes after approval then validates expanded size/hash/CRC while writing. No expansion prepasses. Optional --verify-readback defaults off; progress on long phases.
changes.readback_reporting: Skipped readback: readback_requested=false, bytes_verified=0, no readback_sha256. Source hash reflects written stream. Inactive-root updater explicitly retains full slot readback before activation_ready.
changes.accepted_tradeoff: Malformed authenticated gzip can fail during writing after partially modifying target; report remains failure and partition table is not refreshed.

independent_review.boot: Passed after two stale0600-only image validators were corrected.
independent_review.installer_recovery: Passed after restoring verify_stream utility for standalone ARM verifier compatibility.
independent_review.integration_delta: Passed safety review after updater explicitly requested readback; final status wording uses target to avoid implying whole-disk verification for root-slot updates.

validation.initial_discovery_failure: Three updater regressions exposed shared engine default change; fixed production caller to retain explicit readback; complete rerun passed.

limits: Physical permission repair, DHCP lease and SSH with both keys not yet observed.
